diagnosis: The document share lookup route retrieves a DocumentShare record by primary key without checking if req.user.email matches the intended recipient. A Sequelize afterFind hook automatically fetches the associated ConfidentialDocument record and attaches it to the response object. Any logged-in user can access private legal agreements, financial models, and corporate strategy files by guessing share IDs.

GET /api/shares/share_mna_board_approval_2026 HTTP/1.1
Host: secure.fileshare.internal:8108
Authorization: Bearer <low_privilege_user_token>
